rules: Only canonical successfully issued goods SI completes a delivery batch. Draft number, PDF upload, charge SI and payment are not completion triggers.
Unpaid invoices remain collectible in Transactions without occupying an operational Desk.
Short receipt alone does not close or reduce a customer shipment instruction.
Support may continue loading or transfer the exact shortload remainder to existing Desk 0 awaiting arrangement. Customer cancellation remains an authorized Sales decision.

Partial SI requires the original shortload disposition to be confirmed. SI confirmation must explain the quantity invoiced and retained remainder. A timeout must recover the same disposition/SI requests.
New Desk use must have an unambiguous batch association before pre-SI files are uploaded. Reuse existing identities and state, not a separate collection or duplicate balance.
New batch metadata and file list cannot inherit the prior batch. Old delivery and invoice screens use their own frozen snapshots.
Archived batches must never become active Warehouse tasks again. Loaded sources and invoice references remain unchanged.
acceptance: All three completed Desks can accept later orders without a Desk 4.
The SAME original order reuses Desk 1 after a partial invoice; old/new files, shipment details, Loaded and invoice quantities remain separated.
30 ordered,22 received: receipt leaves8 outstanding; loading22 and confirmed transfer8 toUnassigned permits SI22, then a later batch8.
300 allocated/290 loaded: continue10 and transfer10 toUnassigned are distinct; neither silently cancels demand or changes physical stock.
Old unsaved Warehouse forms cannot load a completed SI batch after the Desk is reused.
Interrupted SI and original retry recover one invoice and one completion; competing assignment/authorization retains revision fencing.
Pre-SI and post-SI PDFs remain attached only to their batch; legacy ambiguous linkage fails closed instead of guessing.
Finance balances/payments, NCT/GHR isolation, Warehouse monetary redaction and single Loaded deduction remain unchanged.
Pure reads create no new Activity entries.
